title: RoomMediaPipeline.close() never releases fallback resources registered while the pipeline is idle
test: tests/roomMediaPipeline.test.js: 'RoomMediaPipeline.close() closes a resource and a timer owned while the pipeline was idle', 'RoomMediaPipeline.closeFallback() drains a resource owned after a cancelling closeFallback()', 'RoomMediaPipeline.close() closes a resource owned after a cancelling closeFallback() exactly once', 'RoomMediaPipeline idle drains keep WHIP ownership and reverse registration order', 'a startup cancelled by closeFallback() still closes the transport its continuation owns after the cancel'
proof: On the unchanged code these five tests failed: close() on a pipeline that never started left a worker and a timer owned while idle open (closed list [] instead of ['timer:7', 'worker']); a resource and timer owned after a cancelling closeFallback() were not closed by the next closeFallback() (['transport'] instead of ['transport', 'timer:9', 'worker']) or by close() (close count 0 !== 1); an idle closeFallback() left three idle-owned resources open while WHIP ownership stayed untouched; and the integration case, where startFallbackRelay is cancelled by closeFallback() while router.createDirectTransport is pending, left the transport the cancelled continuation then owned open ('the transport created after the cancel is closed once': [] instead of ['video-transport']), because the continuation's catch calls stopFallbackRelay -> closeFallback(), which returned early on state 'idle'. After the fix closeFallback() drains _resources when idle (returning false, leaving the generation and the close notification alone) and close() drains _resources itself before the WHIP resources. All five pass. 'RoomMediaPipeline reports a fallback closed once per beginStart across restarts' passes before and after (onClose count stays 1 per started fallback); the four older pipeline tests and the startup-failure test pass before and after.
